info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Settlement Accounts API
info.description: The Settlement Accounts API provides access to detailed information regarding various settlement accounts within the financial ecosystem. This API allows users to retrieve account data, facilitating monitoring and management of financial transactions. Typical consumers of this API include financial institutions, accounting software, and payment processing systems that require seamless access to account balances and transaction histories. By leveraging this API, businesses can enhance their financial operations and improve reporting accuracy.

get.summary: Retrieve a list of settlement accounts.
get.description: This endpoint allows clients to fetch all available settlement accounts. It provides details such as account numbers, balances, and associated data to aid in managing financial transactions effectively.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving settlement accounts. It should contain the necessary parameters to specify which accounts to fetch.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the list of settlement accounts.
